zh: 原创潮玩角色，一颗米白圆核和一封还想替谁说句话的未寄出的信长在一起：整枚信封就是它的身体，拿掉信就没有角色。一枚竖立的厚信封围成胸腹，正中一粒还没拆的深绛圆蜡封，底边两枚短钝足。信封上沿是一颗米白圆核小头，几乎没有颈，被折口轻轻挡住一点，半睁小黑豆眼，极小一字嘴，视线平视前方。双足左右分开站稳，信封垂直微微前倾，像话已经折好，还没舍得寄出。主体是米白短绒，只有那粒蜡封是未干的深绛蜡。配色是米白配深绛。信封上没有文字、姓名、地址或邮戳，蜡封完整，没有撕开。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要可阅读的文字和数字，不要颁奖奖杯，不要发光屏幕，不要锁链或伤口。
enp: Original designer toy character: a rice-white rounded core fused with an unsent letter that still wants to speak for someone — the envelope is the body, without it there is no character. A thick standing envelope forms the torso, a deep-crimson round wax seal still unbroken at the center, two short blunt feet below. A rice-white rounded head sits at the top edge, almost no neck, slightly tucked by the fold, half-open tiny black bean eyes, a tiny straight mouth, gaze level ahead. Feet planted apart, the envelope standing vertical and slightly leaning forward, as if the words are already folded and not yet given away. Body is rice-white plush; only the seal is uncured deep-crimson wax. Colors: rice-white with deep crimson. The envelope has no letters, names, addresses or postmarks, and the seal is intact, not torn. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No readable letters or numerals, no award trophy, no lit screens, no chains or injuries.
